head.t: Medtronic diabetes spin-off weighs on annual revenue guidance
head.x: MassDevice reports that the separation of Medtronic's diabetes business has weighed on revenue guidance; cardiovascular grew 10% with electrophysiology sales up 18%.

head.t: Medtronic continues to see growth in cardiovascular business
head.x: Medtronic's cardiovascular unit grew by double digits in its fiscal second quarter, supported by its cardiac ablation portfolio (MedTech Dive).

head.t: FDA clears Medtronic's Hugo robot for general surgery
head.x: FDA has cleared Medtronic's Hugo robotic-assisted system for upper abdominal general surgery (e.g. small bowel resection, cholecystectomy, ventral hernia repair) plus appendectomy and inguinal hernia repair, beyond its prior urology indications.

f.t: Medtronic to acquire Contego Medical (Neuroguard carotid systems, Excipio thrombectomy) for $380m
f.x: Medtronic announced on 16/11/2026 that it will acquire Contego Medical, a privately held company, valued at $380m with potential payments post-acquisition.

Medtronic today announced its intent to acquire Contego Medical. A press release notes that the acquisition will build on Medtronic’s US distribution agreement with Contego, first announced in January 2025.
